story: Will Paquin's fingerstyle guitar covers took off online from 2020, and "Chandelier" brought listeners to his own songs; by 2024 he had played almost no shows. He played Pickathon that summer. His first album, Hahaha, came out in 2025, and that November he made his first European run, from Paradiso in Amsterdam to Pitchfork's Avant-Garde in Paris.
